entities.blurb: Every advancement in the game, laid out as the five in-game tabs and the order they unlock in. Each one links to its own page with the requirement, the flavour text, and the experience reward.
entities.name: Advancements

When the Squad Hops into Town

entities.blurb: Smithing templates used to apply decorative trim patterns to armor pieces at a smithing table.
entities.name: Armor Trims

entities.blurb: Mobs in the #minecraft:arthropod entity type tag. Arthropods take extra damage from Bane of Arthropods, which also applies Slowness IV.
entities.name: Arthropod Mobs

entities.blurb: Patterns used at a loom to apply special designs to banners. A pattern item is kept in the pattern slot and is not consumed when crafting.
entities.name: Banner Patterns

entities.blurb: Every item that can be placed into a composter to produce bone meal, and its chance to add a composting layer.
entities.name: Compostable Items

entities.blurb: Every enchantment in the game, with its maximum level. Treasure enchantments cannot be found at an enchanting table and are marked in the wiki's own data.
entities.name: Enchantments

entities.blurb: Every item that can be burned in furnaces, smokers, and blast furnaces, with its burn duration and smelting capacity.
entities.name: Furnace Fuel

entities.blurb: Rail-riding vehicles for transport, storage, and utility. Four variants are crafted from an ordinary minecart and an installed block; the spawner and command block minecarts are creative-only.
entities.name: Minecarts

entities.blurb: Every structure that generates in the world, as listed in the worldgen/structure registry. Each one links to its own page with placement details, biomes, and loot tables.
entities.name: Structures

entities.blurb: Mobs in the #minecraft:undead entity type tag. Undead mobs take extra damage from Smite, are hurt by Instant Health, and are healed by Instant Damage. Knowing which mobs qualify matters when choosing between Smite and Sharpness.
entities.name: Undead Mobs

entities.blurb: Every edible item, with what it restores. Nutrition is the hunger points restored on eating; saturation is the hidden value that delays hunger from ticking down again.
entities.name: Food

entities.blurb: Job site blocks used by unemployed villagers to acquire professions and replenish trades.
entities.name: Villager Workstations
